title: Coherent Grover-BHMT Quantum Amplitude Amplification of CNOT Syndrome Branches
claims: Applying k coherent Grover-BHMT reflection steps prior to CNOT syndrome readout rotates the marked syndrome branch probability from p_0 = sin^2(theta_0) to P_k(p_0) = sin^2((2k + 1) * theta_0) while preserving 100% survivor state fidelity.
For any weight-3 CNOT witness (p_0 = 2^{-(3-1)} = 1/4, theta_0 = pi/6), a single amplification step (k = 1) achieves 100% deterministic syndrome preparation (P_1 = 1.0).
For a weight-2 witness (p_0 = 1/2), standard pi-reflection over-rotates to sin^2(3*pi/4) = 1/2.
